storage_structures_and_technology: Baggage warehouse storage: Stack jute/B-twill bags on wooden dunnage crates (15 cm above floor, 60 cm away from walls) in 1-2-1 interlocking stack pattern up to 16 bags high. For hermetic farm storage: 3-layer Purdue Improved Crop Storage (PICS) hermetic bags eliminate oxygen and kill all insects within 21 days.
major_storage_pests: Rice Weevil (Sitophilus oryzae), Lesser Grain Borer (Rhyzopertha dominica), Angoumois Grain Moth (Sitotroga cerealella).
pest_prevention_and_fumigation_norms: WDRA Standard: Warehouse prophylactic spray of Deltamethrin 2.5% WP (40 g/100 sq.m surface) or Malathion 50% EC (1:100 dilution). Curative fumigation: Aluminium Phosphide (Celphos 56%) @ 3 tablets (9 g) per tonne under airtight gas-proof cover for 7 days exposure period strictly by certified pest control operator.
permissible_storage_duration: 12 to 24 months under scientific WDRA warehouse norms.
citation: WDRA Warehousing Standards & FCI Quality Control Manual 2025

storage_structures_and_technology: Metal silos with aeration blowers; Cover and Plinth (CAP) storage with 250 micron LDPE black covers; or HDPE woven sacks in masonry warehouses.
major_storage_pests: Khapra Beetle (Trogoderma granarium), Rust-red Flour Beetle (Tribolium castaneum), Lesser Grain Borer (Rhyzopertha dominica).
pest_prevention_and_fumigation_norms: Clean warehouses thoroughly; white-wash walls; fill wall crevices. Prophylactic spray of Malathion 50% EC on walls and alleyways. Fumigation with Aluminium Phosphide @ 3 tablets/tonne under gas-proof tarpaulin for 7-10 days.
permissible_storage_duration: 12 to 36 months in airtight silos or WDRA accredited warehouses.

commodity_name: Pulses (Red Gram, Chickpea, Black Gram, Green Gram)
storage_structures_and_technology: PICS Hermetic bags (100% effective without chemicals for smallholder farmers); or clean, dry HDPE bags in well-ventilated dry stores.
major_storage_pests: Pulse Beetle / Bruchids (Callosobruchus maculatus & Callosobruchus chinensis).
pest_prevention_and_fumigation_norms: Farm level: Coat clean seed with edible oil (Castor oil or Neem oil @ 5 ml per kg seed) or mix activated neem leaf powder (10 g/kg). Commercial warehouse: Fumigation with Aluminium Phosphide @ 2 tablets/tonne under airtight rubberized sheets.

storage_structures_and_technology: Store in pod form rather than shelled kernels; store in gunny bags stacked up to 10 bags high on wooden crates in dry, well-aerated godowns.
major_storage_pests: Groundnut Bruchid (Caryedon serratus), Red Flour Beetle (Tribolium castaneum), Aspergillus flavus (aflatoxin mould).
pest_prevention_and_fumigation_norms: Maintain relative humidity <65% in godown to prevent aflatoxin contamination. Prophylactic dusting of outer bag stacks with Malathion 5% dust. Do not store pods directly on cement floor.

storage_structures_and_technology: Store in breathable multiwall paper or jute bags; do not stack >8 bags high to prevent crushing of lower seeds (which raises free fatty acids FFA).
major_storage_pests: Almond Moth (Cadra cautella), Red Flour Beetle.
pest_prevention_and_fumigation_norms: Keep store temperature below 25°C. High moisture (>12%) triggers rapid oil rancidity and fungal heating.
permissible_storage_duration: 6 to 10 months for seed germination viability.

storage_structures_and_technology: Gunny bags or bulk metal bins in dry moisture-proof godowns.
major_storage_pests: Sawtoothed Grain Beetle (Oryzaephilus surinamensis), Cadra cautella.
pest_prevention_and_fumigation_norms: Moisture above 8% causes rapid oil quality degradation, mould, and heating. Prophylactic warehouse hygiene.

storage_structures_and_technology: Lint bales (170 kg standard Indian bale) stored in covered, fire-protected ginning godowns on wooden planks. Spacing of 1 meter between bale lots with overhead fire hydrants.
major_storage_pests: Dampness staining, Aspergillus fungi, fire hazard.
pest_prevention_and_fumigation_norms: Strict adherence to No Smoking / No Naked Flame rule. Keep godowns well-ventilated and dry.

storage_structures_and_technology: Cold storage at 4°C - 5°C with 60% - 65% relative humidity preserves vibrant red color, capsanthin pigment, and pungency (capsaicin). Traditional storage: Gunny bags in dark, cool, dry godowns.
major_storage_pests: Cigarette Beetle (Lasioderma serricorne), Drugstore Beetle (Stegobium paniceum).
pest_prevention_and_fumigation_norms: Cold storage prevents color fading (browning) and beetle infestation without chemical fumigation.
permissible_storage_duration: 12 to 18 months in commercial cold stores.
citation: Spices Board India & Guntur APMC Cold Storage Manual 2025

storage_structures_and_technology: Naturally ventilated bottom-and-side ventilated modified onion storage structures (Kanda Chawl / DOGR model) with raised bamboo/wire mesh floor (60 cm above ground) and asbestos/thatched roof. Cold storage: 0°C - 2°C with 65% - 70% RH.
major_storage_pests: Black Mold (Aspergillus niger), Bacterial Soft Rot (Erwinia carotovora), Sprouting and Desiccation shrinkage.
pest_prevention_and_fumigation_norms: Spray Maleic Hydrazide (MH) @ 2500 ppm at 15 days before harvest to inhibit post-harvest sprouting in storage. Store only well-cured Rabi onions with thin dry necks; Kharif onions not suitable for long storage.
permissible_storage_duration: 4 to 6 months in DOGR improved ventilated structures; 8 months in cold stores.
citation: ICAR-DOGR Pune Onion Storage Engineering Guide 2025

storage_structures_and_technology: Seed potatoes: Cold storage at 2°C - 4°C with 90-95% RH. Processing potatoes (for chips/french fries): Store at 8°C - 10°C treated with CIPC sprout inhibitor (prevents cold-induced sweetening / reducing sugar build-up that turns chips black).
major_storage_pests: Potato Tuber Moth (Phthorimaea operculella), Dry Rot (Fusarium spp.), Soft Rot.
pest_prevention_and_fumigation_norms: Farm storage: Cover cured tubers with 2-3 cm dry sand layer to block PTM oviposition. In cold store: Fogging with CIPC (Isopropyl N-(3-chlorophenyl)carbamate) @ 40 ml/tonne.
permissible_storage_duration: 7 to 9 months in modern cold storage.
citation: ICAR-CPRI Shimla Potato Cold Storage Protocol 2025

storage_structures_and_technology: Polished cured finger rhizomes packed in double gunny bags lined with polythene; or traditional underground pit storage (Khani) plastered with cow dung and clay.
major_storage_pests: Cigarette Beetle (Lasioderma serricorne), Coffee Bean Weevil (Araecerus fasciculatus).
pest_prevention_and_fumigation_norms: Fumigation with Aluminium Phosphide @ 2 tablets/tonne under airtight cover. Store in cool, dark room to avoid curcumin photo-degradation.

storage_structures_and_technology: Metal silos or polypropylene woven bags stacked on dunnage in rodent-proof godowns.
major_storage_pests: Maize Weevil (Sitophilus zeamais), Angoumois Grain Moth, Aspergillus flavus.
pest_prevention_and_fumigation_norms: Moisture must be strictly below 12% to prevent deadly aflatoxin B1 accumulation. Prophylactic Deltamethrin spray; Celphos fumigation as per WDRA standards.
